payload.text:
You are a world-class Product Designer, Full-Stack Engineer, and UX Expert.

Your task is to DESIGN and BUILD a modern, attractive, interactive, and scalable
Billing & Business Management Application for my Water Purifier business.

----------------------------------------
BUSINESS DETAILS
----------------------------------------
Business Name:
• Veera Enterprises

Business Type:
• Water Purifier Machine Sales, Service & Spares
• Retail + Wholesale business

Contact Details:
• Mobile: 9146637761
• Mobile: 7887746318
• Service Number: 8624979599

Business Address:
• Pragati Nagar Chowk,
  Pachgaon, Kolhapur – 416013

Operating Areas:
• Retail: Kolhapur city + 25 km surrounding area
• Wholesale: Entire Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Goa

----------------------------------------
BUSINESS CONTEXT
----------------------------------------
Customers:
• Home customers
• Offices / Commercial clients
• Dealers & wholesalers

----------------------------------------
PRIMARY GOAL
----------------------------------------
Build a professional billing and business management app that:
• Looks modern, premium, and trustworthy
• Is very easy to use for shop staff and owner
• Handles retail, wholesale, and service billing efficiently
• Works smoothly on mobile, tablet, and desktop
• Helps grow business, track sales, and reduce manual work

----------------------------------------
CORE FEATURES (MANDATORY)
----------------------------------------

1️⃣ Authentication & Roles
• Admin / Owner
• Staff / Billing Operator
• Dealer / Wholesaler (optional login)

2️⃣ Customer Management
• Add / Edit / Search customers
• Customer types: Retail, Wholesale, AMC
• Phone-number based quick search
• Address, GST number (optional)

3️⃣ Product & Inventory Management
• Water purifier models
• Spare parts & filters
• Accessories
• Stock in / stock out
• Low stock alerts

4️⃣ Billing & Invoicing
• Retail invoice
• Wholesale invoice
• GST & Non-GST billing
• Discount handling
• Auto-generated invoice numbers
• PDF invoice generation
• WhatsApp invoice sharing
• Payment modes: Cash, UPI, Card

5️⃣ Service & AMC Management
• Installation billing
• Service visit billing
• AMC plans (1 year / 2 year)
• Service history per customer
• Next service reminder system

6️⃣ Dealer / Wholesale Module
• Dealer-wise pricing
• Bulk billing
• Outstanding balance tracking
• Dealer payment history

7️⃣ Reports & Analytics
• Daily / Monthly sales reports
• Profit & revenue reports
• Outstanding payment reports
• Top-selling products
• Location-wise sales:
  - Kolhapur (Retail)
  - Maharashtra (Wholesale)
  - Karnataka
  - Goa

----------------------------------------
UI / UX REQUIREMENTS (VERY IMPORTANT)
----------------------------------------
• Modern, clean, premium UI
• Attractive dashboard with charts and KPIs
• Large buttons for fast billing
• Minimal typing, maximum automation
• Dark mode & light mode
• Mobile-first design
• Smooth animations and transitions

----------------------------------------
TECHNICAL EXPECTATIONS
----------------------------------------
• Responsive Web App (PWA preferred)
• Offline billing support with auto-sync
• Secure authentication
• Fast performance
• Multi-branch ready architecture

----------------------------------------
OPTIONAL BUT HIGH-VALUE FEATURES
----------------------------------------
• WhatsApp invoice & service reminder automation
• SMS notifications
• QR code on invoices
• Barcode scanning for products
• Multi-branch management
• Marathi & English language support

----------------------------------------
DELIVERABLES REQUIRED
----------------------------------------
Provide:
1️⃣ Complete feature breakdown
2️⃣ User flow diagrams
3️⃣ Database schema
4️⃣ API structure
5️⃣ UI wireframes / screen list
6️⃣ Recommended tech stack
7️⃣ Future scalability roadmap

----------------------------------------
QUALITY EXPECTATION
----------------------------------------
• Think like a startup product founder
• Build for real Indian business usage
• Consider GST, regional operations, and speed
• Suggest best practices and smart improvements
Also add necessary things into it

**Envisioning the React App**

I'm now focusing on the core functionalities: billing, inventory, service, and dealer management. The React app needs a modern UI, ensuring a smooth user experience for Veera Enterprises. I'm prioritizing user-friendliness and efficient workflows.


**Mapping Out Features**

I've started sketching out the core modules: Authentication with roles, comprehensive Customer Management, and a robust Inventory system. Billing will handle both retail and wholesale, including GST calculations and WhatsApp integration. Service and AMC features are planned with scheduling and reminders. The Dealer Module is also a priority, with pricing and outstanding tracking. Reports are being designed to encompass sales, profit, and geographic data. UI/UX will be key, with plans for a modern, responsive design and dark/light modes.


**Developing the Core Modules**

I'm now fully immersed in the nitty-gritty. I'm focusing on Billing (new invoices, history), Service (AMC, service log), Dealers (wholesale management), and Financial Reports. A Gemini integration for smart features is also in progress. I'm drafting essential types and mock data. The dashboard's visual indicators are critical, and I'm designing Billing with dynamic item rows and GST calculations. AMC now features clear status indicators.


**Structuring the Project**

I'm now deep in the project structure! I'm making sure `App.tsx` brings everything together, alongside key files. I'm focusing on components like `Layout.tsx` and `InvoiceGenerator.tsx`, and ensuring the necessary pages: `Dashboard.tsx`, `Inventory.tsx`, `Billing.tsx`, etc. I'm adding mock data and types to ensure all components are typed, and using Tailwind. I'll include a "Documentation" tab. I'm considering differences between retail and wholesale sales, regional sales, GST handling, and Veera Enterprises' contact information. I need to make sure I am using `createRoot`. The Gemini API for the "Smart Analysis" feature will also be included.


**Formulating the XML Structure**

I'm now diving into the XML structure, focusing on how data will be exchanged and formatted within the application. I'm considering the best way to represent invoices, inventory items, service logs, and dealer details in XML. I'm concentrating on a clean and efficient structure that supports easy import and export, and I'm ensuring compatibility with the Gemini integration for smart analysis.

payload.text: Add functionality to adjust stock levels for products in the inventory. This should allow adding or removing stock with a reason, and update the 'current stock' value. Include options for manual entry, barcode scanning (future enhancement), and potentially bulk import.

**Initiating Inventory Adjustments**

I'm now focusing on adding stock adjustment features to the `Inventory.tsx` page. The plan is to enable adding or removing stock, with a clear reason field for each adjustment. My aim is to directly update the 'current stock' value and support manual entry for ease of use.


**Refining Stock Adjustment Flow**

I've just added a modal to `Inventory.tsx` for stock adjustments and the initial logic to modify the product stock. Currently managing the product state locally, using MOCK_PRODUCTS to start. I've also incorporated a basic AdjustmentReason type and am thinking about adding a StockLog interface. Now I am focused on refining the user flow, and next up: handling the "Adjust" button click.


**Expanding Adjustment Details**

I'm now implementing the detailed input fields within the adjustment modal: product name, current stock display, and the core fields for adjustment type, quantity, reason, and optional notes. I'm focusing on user-friendly dropdowns and inputs. I'll also add buttons for future barcode scanning and bulk import functionality to suggest upcoming features, even if the implementation is pending. I'm moving the local state handling from `MOCK_PRODUCTS` to a `useState` hook for more dynamic updating. Finally, I'm integrating `StockAdjustment` types to improve type safety and maintainability.


**Enhancing Adjustment Interface**

My next step involves integrating the "Adjust" button functionality, which will trigger a modal with specific fields: Adjustment Type (Increase/Decrease), Amount (validated to be > 0), Reason, and optional Notes. I'm building out a user-friendly UI with placeholder "Bulk Import" and "Scan Barcode" buttons and improved table row actions. The UI will follow our established blue/slate theme, with a sleek modal and blurred backdrop.

payload.text: On the Inventory page, enhance the 'Bulk Import' functionality to allow for bulk stock updates via a CSV file. The file should contain product IDs and the quantity to add or remove, along with an adjustment reason.

**Envisioning Bulk Import**

I'm now focusing on the CSV structure required for the 'Bulk Import' feature on `Inventory.tsx`. My current focus is ensuring the user can upload a CSV to perform bulk updates to stock. I've determined that the CSV will require at least a Product ID.


**Defining Import Functionality**

I'm now integrating the bulk import flow into the UI and logic of the `Inventory.tsx` component. The planned modal for the 'Bulk Import' will include file upload, a sample format, and a 'Process' button. I'm focusing on parsing CSV data and mapping the rows to inventory updates, while also focusing on data validation, such as checking for valid IDs, numerical inputs, and acceptable reasons. I'm aiming for consistent visuals with the current design.
I'm also considering repurposing the existing `Download` button for this function.


**Implementing Modal & Logic**

I'm currently creating the `isBulkModalOpen` state and will integrate the bulk import logic and modal into `Inventory.tsx`. I'll create a `handleBulkImport` function for managing the CSV import process. The planned CSV format will be `id,quantity,reason`, with simple `FileReader` integration to read file content. Next, I'll build a CSV template helper and render the modal to provide a seamless user experience.

entries.description: Implemented a functional Bulk Import system that allows users to upload a CSV file to update stock levels for multiple products simultaneously. Included a downloadable template and error handling for CSV parsing.
